item.title: 🤖 AI Journey 2026: 300+ key Russian and international AI experts The internatio…
item.description: 🤖 AI Journey 2026: 300+ key Russian and international AI experts The international AI Journey conference will take place in Moscow from November 26 to 28, with scientists, developers and tech companies from Russia, China, India, Serbia, Brazil, Kenya, Kazakhstan, the UAE and beyond. 📅 November 26: Society. A key topic is AI agents: Chinese sci-fi writer Chen Qiufan, co-author of AI 2041, will talk about the role of humans in this new world. Also on the agenda: AI in healthcare, sports and transportation, plus a podcast on tech in the creative industries and ESG. 💼 November 27: Business. The latest AI solutions and AI adoption across the economy. Speakers include current and former executives of Tencent and Huawei, an expert from ByteDance and 16-year-old Indian entrepreneur Raul Aju. 🔬 November 28: Science. AI in research, next-gen models, autonomous agents and physical AI, with Natasa Przulj (MBZUAI), Valerii Babushkin (BP) and Ivan Oseledets (AIRI, MSU). 👉 Check out the program
